ambiguities.question: Does B59 already cover adaptive multi-modulus transcripts?
ambiguities.resolution: No. B59 covers five named explicit cubic representations; its independent J1 review expressly left multiple target-blind moduli open because no total-query transcript bound was supplied.

ambiguities.question: Does a generic same-transcript polynomial pair settle the elliptic case?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It is a nearby-object control only. A negative elliptic conclusion requires a certificate on the complete reachable marked elliptic image.
ambiguities.basis: B59 Reviewer and Red Team limitations.
